---
title: "Pythagorean theorem (test post)"
date: 2026-09-12
---

The Pythagorean theorem states that in a right triangle with legs of
length $a$ and $b$ and hypotenuse of length $c$,
$$
a^2 + b^2 = c^2.
$$

A simple example is $a=3$, $b=4$, $c=5$, since $3^2 + 4^2 = 9 + 16 = 25 = 5^2$.

```{=html}
<svg viewBox="0 0 340 260" width="100%" style="max-width: 420px; display: block; margin: 2em auto;" role="img" aria-label="A right triangle with legs 3 and 4 and hypotenuse 5">
  <polygon points="40,220 40,40 240,220" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  <path d="M 40,200 L 60,200 L 60,220" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="20" y="135" fill="currentColor" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">a = 3</text>
  <text x="140" y="240" fill="currentColor" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">b = 4</text>
  <text x="160" y="128" fill="currentColor" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">c = 5</text>
</svg>
```

For a right triangle, the incircle (the largest circle that fits inside it, tangent to
all three sides) has radius
$$
r = \frac{a+b-c}{2}.
$$
For $a=3$, $b=4$, $c=5$, this gives $r = \frac{3+4-5}{2} = 1$, so the incircle has
area $\pi r^2 = \pi$ and circumference $2\pi r = 2\pi$.

```{=html}
<svg viewBox="0 0 340 280" width="100%" style="max-width: 420px; display: block; margin: 2em auto;" role="img" aria-label="The same right triangle with its incircle of radius 1 drawn and marked">
  <polygon points="60,230 60,80 260,230" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  <path d="M 60,210 L 80,210 L 80,230" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" />
  <circle cx="110" cy="180" r="50" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="110" y1="180" x2="110" y2="230" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 3" />
  <circle cx="110" cy="180" r="2.5" fill="currentColor" />
  <text x="40" y="160" fill="currentColor" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">a = 3</text>
  <text x="160" y="250" fill="currentColor" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">b = 4</text>
  <text x="178" y="148" fill="currentColor" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">c = 5</text>
  <text x="128" y="212" fill="currentColor" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">r = 1</text>
</svg>
```
